sections.description:
The AI-Powered WordPress Form Builder That Makes Form Creation Effortless

Say goodbye to complex, clunky form builders. FormGent is a modern, no-code WordPress form builder plugin made for speed, simplicity, and flexibility. Whether it’s a contact form, multi-step form, survey, payment form, or smart conditional form, FormGent helps you build it effortlessly using the WordPress block editor.

Designed for business owners, developers, and marketers alike, FormGent offers a smooth drag-and-drop experience with zero coding. It’s built by wpWax, the team behind Directorist, the leading WordPress directory plugin.

FormGent is not just another form plugin—it’s your next-gen form solution. With built-in features like AI-powered form creation, conversational & multi-step forms, conditional logic, quizzes(upcoming), and payment integration(upcoming), it’s built to grow with your needs and boost user engagement.

Whether you’re collecting leads, feedback, or payments, FormGent helps you do it faster, smarter, and without limits. Our mission is to simplify form building so you can focus on what matters most: collecting data and driving user engagement.

Ready to create powerful forms with ease? Let FormGent take care of the hard work.

👉 Join Our FB Community : FormGent Community

👉 Official Facebook Page : Like and Follow on Facebook

👉 Official Linkedin Page: Follow on LinkedIn

👉 Official YouTube Channel : Follow on YouTube

👉 Official Support : Contact

Key Features:

1. AI-Powered Form Creation: Build Unlimited Forms with Ease

Imagine creating custom forms effortlessly. FormGent’s AI engine does exactly that. Whether designing a basic contact form builder or a complex multi-step survey, AI handles the heavy lifting, offering field suggestions and optimizing user experience. No technical expertise is required—FormGent ensures your forms are functional, user-friendly, and perfectly suited to your audience.

2. Conversational Forms

A truly exceptional form builder stands out by offering diverse form creation capabilities, and FormGent excels in this regard. At its core is the innovative Conversational Forms feature, designed to transform the user experience. Unlike conventional forms that overwhelm users with multiple fields, conversational forms deliver one question at a time, fostering focus and reducing distractions. This dynamic approach not only enhances user engagement but also drives significantly higher completion rates.

3. Mobile-First, User-Centric Design

In today’s mobile-first world, responsive forms are essential. FormGent’s WordPress form builder creates stunning forms that adapt to any device, providing users with a flawless experience, whether on a desktop, tablet, or smartphone. It also adheres to accessibility standards, making your forms usable by everyone.

4. Native WordPress Integration: Seamless Form Building

FormGent fully leverages the power of WordPress native block editor, offering an intuitive WP form builder experience. With its smooth, drag & drop based form builder interface, you don’t need to navigate multiple systems. FormGent keeps it simple while saving you time.

5. Instant Forms: Share & Publish Effortlessly

Need a form ready in seconds? With FormGent, you can create and publish forms instantly via a unique URL, making them easily shareable on the web, via email, or across social media platforms.

6. Multi-Step Forms

Turn long forms into engaging conversations. Our multi-step form feature transforms complex forms into step-by-step guided experiences, increasing form completion rates and delivering a personalized user journey.

7. Coming Soon: Payments, Quizzes & More

Get excited for future updates! Soon, FormGent will support payments, quizzes, and more, turning your WordPress form builder into a complete solution for all your form-building needs—without requiring extra plugins.

8. Smart Conditional Logic: Personalize Every Interaction

FormGent’s powerful Conditional Logic lets you show or hide fields based on user input—creating forms that adapt in real time. Deliver a smarter, cleaner experience by asking only what’s relevant, reducing friction and boosting completion rates.

9. Analytics & Insights: Optimize Your Forms

FormGent offers built-in analytics, allowing you to track how users interact with your forms, see where they drop off, and understand engagement patterns. Use these insights to optimize future forms and boost completion rates.

10. Fast, Lightweight, and Powerful

FormGent is built for performance. This WP form builder is lightweight and efficient, ensuring your website runs smoothly, even as you add complex forms.

11. Data Integration with Webhooks

An advanced form builder isn’t complete without seamless data integration, and FormGent takes it a step further with its Webhook feature. This powerful tool allows you to instantly connect your forms with external applications and services. By automatically sending real-time data to your preferred platforms, webhooks streamline your workflow and eliminate the need for manual data handling.

12. Incomplete Data Save

A defining feature of any advanced form builder is its ability to handle incomplete data effectively, and FormGent sets the bar high in this area. With its Incomplete Data Save functionality, partially filled form submissions are automatically saved in real-time. This ensures users can resume their progress without losing valuable input, reducing frustration and improving completion rates.

13. iFrame Embed: Share Anywhere, Collect Everywhere

Need to use your form outside WordPress? With FormGent’s iFrame Embed feature, you can easily share and display forms on non-WordPress websites, landing pages, or even other WordPress sites. Just copy the embed code and paste it anywhere—no extra tools, no hassle. It’s the perfect way to expand your reach, collect responses from multiple platforms, and keep your workflow unified.

Some Powerful Features at a Glance:

  • Unlimited Forms: Whether it’s a basic contact form or a multi-step survey, FormGent allows you to create unlimited forms effortlessly.
  • Mobile-First Design: Fully responsive, ensuring flawless performance across all devices.
  • No-Code, Drag-and-Drop: Perfect for both beginners and advanced users, FormGent’s drag-and-drop-based form builder simplifies form creation.
  • Advanced Analytics & Insights: Track user engagement with detailed metrics.
  • Fast & Lightweight: Performance-focused to keep your site fast.
  • Conversational Forms: Create conversional forms effortlessly.

Why Choose FormGent?

  • Simple Yet Powerful: A user-friendly interface paired with powerful features like AI, quizzes, and payment integrations.
  • All-in-One Solution: Everything you need in one WordPress form builder—no extra plugins required.
  • AI Form Building: Future-proof and optimized solution with the power of AI form building capacity.

Available Form Blocks in FormGent:

  • Name Field
  • Email Field
  • Single-Line Text
  • Multi-Line Text (Textarea)
  • Number Field
  • Dropdown Field
  • Single Choice (Radio Button)
  • Multiple Choice (Checkboxes)
  • Address Field
  • GDPR Consent Field
  • Website URL Field
  • Digital Signature
  • Phone Number
  • File Upload (New)
  • Page Break (New)
  • Captcha (New)
  • Date & Time Picker (New)
  • Rating (New)
  • Input Masking (New)

Who is FormGent For?

  • Business Owners & Entrepreneurs: Collect leads, manage surveys, and accept payments—all with one plugin.
  • Agencies & Developers: Offer clients a seamless WordPress form builder experience.
  • Marketers & Educators: Create quizzes, gather feedback, and analyze user data to improve engagement.
  • Freelancers: Build forms quickly without needing coding expertise.

FormGent is Just Getting Started 🎉

We’re always improving FormGent to meet the needs of our users. Do feature suggestions? Let us know through our Feedback Form. Together, we’ll make FormGent even better!

How It Works:

FormGent is designed for simplicity. Here’s how you can quickly start using this drag-and-drop-based form builder:

Step 1: Install the FormGent Plugin

From your WordPress dashboard, go to “Plugins,” search for “FormGent,” click “Install Now,” and activate it.

Step 2: Build Your Form

Once activated, head to the FormGent dashboard, where you can easily create new forms using the drag-and-drop form builder within the editor.

Step 3: Embed Your Form

After creating your form, embed it in any post or page using a shortcode or directly through the block.

Step 4: Analyze Results

Access the “All Responses” section to review form submissions, user engagement metrics, and completion data, making it easy to optimize your forms.

Privacy Policy

FormGent uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default. The SDK only starts gathering basic telemetry data when a user allows it via the admin notice. We collect the data to ensure a great user experience for all our users.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.

Support & Documentation

Need help getting started with FormGent? Our detailed documentation and support team are ready to assist you. Visit our Support Page for step-by-step guides and troubleshooting tips.

With FormGent, building forms in WordPress has never been easier or more powerful. Ready to transform your form-building experience? Start with FormGent today!
sections.faq:
Is FormGent compatible with all WordPress themes?

Yes, FormGent works seamlessly with any modern themes in the market.

Can I create multi-step forms with FormGent?

Yes! You can create multi-step forms with FormGent, allowing you to break long forms into easy, guided steps.

Can I use FormGent with a Page Builder?

Absolutely! FormGent is designed to be fully compatible with all major page builders, ensuring seamless integration without any interference.

Is FormGent optimized for mobile?

Absolutely! FormGent is designed with a mobile-first approach.

Will FormGent support payment forms?

Yes, payment integrations are in the pipeline.

How does FormGent handle user data?

FormGent adheres to GDPR standards, and you can add a GDPR consent field to your forms.

How can I get support if I have an issue?

You can visit our Support Page for help or contact our support team directly. We’re here to assist you with any issues or questions you may have.

Does FormGent require any coding knowledge?

No, FormGent is designed for users of all skill levels. You can create forms without writing any code, thanks to the intuitive drag-and-drop interface.

Can I track form submissions and user engagement?

Absolutely! FormGent provides built-in analytics to track form submissions, user interactions, and more in the All Responses section.
